baseline: Explicit user selection: HGB22/36 columns + frozen GNN33, union41/64 columns
hypothesis: Previously unsigned owner balance collapsed absent flow and one-sided flow into zero. Separate availability, flow direction, transaction amount relative to bidirectional activity, and day-versus-history changes.

formulas.net_direction: (incoming - outgoing)/(incoming + outgoing); NaN when total amount is zero
formulas.flow_support: log1p(incoming event count + outgoing event count); zero if no events; NaN for unknown owner
formulas.amount_vs_external_mean: log1p(target amount / mean external amount across both directions in same currency); NaN for no positive-valued flow
formulas.net_direction_shift: current-day net direction minus strictly prior7d net direction; NaN if either has no positive-valued flow

account_external: Exclude self-account transfers only; different accounts of one owner still count.
owner_external: Both owners must be known and distinct. Unknown owner gets NaN; never pooled.
currency: Source uses paid/payment currency; destination uses received/receiving currency. Aggregation never mixes currency.
history: [day-7,day); day-shift adds current day only, under daily-close contract. All distinct same-minute observations included.
context: All restored observed transactions, never labels or pattern IDs. Full aggregation independent of target sample.
selection: Predeclared families plus <=2 stable single types ranked on train early/late and monitor, matching week,currency,format,amount,endpoint activity. Validation selects frozen candidates once. No candidate/threshold selection on history.
gnn: Frozen adopted33-type network; new features enter HGB only, followed by refitted2-score logistic fusion.
success: Normal-sample P is an estimate. Full population evaluation required before any goal achievement claim.
scope: Complete one recorded follow-up batch; adopted41 remains unchanged. LI-Large remains cancelled. SAML-D is not a fresh selection set.
